controls.title: Architecture, Design and Threat Modeling
controls.summary: Security is designed in: threat modeling, secure SDLC, and documented trust boundaries.

controls.title: Authentication
controls.summary: Authentication controls, credential storage, recovery, and anti-automation are correctly implemented.

controls.title: Session Management
controls.summary: Sessions are generated, protected, rotated, and invalidated securely.

controls.title: Access Control
controls.summary: Access-control decisions are enforced server-side and deny by default.
evidenceExamples: Broken access control / IDOR / CSRF findings

controls.title: Validation, Sanitization and Encoding
controls.summary: Input is validated, output is context-encoded, and injection is prevented across interpreters.
evidenceExamples: XSS / SQL / command / template injection / deserialization findings

controls.title: Stored Cryptography
controls.summary: Cryptographic modules use current approved algorithms; secrets and keys are managed and never hard-coded.
implementationChecklist: Use a secret manager, no hard-coded secrets

controls.title: Error Handling and Logging
controls.summary: Errors and logs do not leak sensitive data and support detection.
implementationChecklist: No sensitive data in errors or logs
evidenceExamples: Sensitive data in logs / verbose error findings

controls.title: Data Protection
controls.summary: Sensitive data is classified, minimized, and protected against unauthorized exposure and caching.

controls.title: Communications Security
controls.summary: All communications use TLS with validated certificates and strong configuration.

controls.title: Malicious Code
controls.summary: Code is free of backdoors, malicious logic, and unsafe dynamic code; dependencies are trustworthy.
implementationChecklist: Review for backdoors and unsafe dynamic code

controls.title: Business Logic
controls.summary: Business-logic flows enforce sequencing, limits, and anti-automation.

controls.title: Files and Resources
controls.summary: File upload, path handling, and external entity processing are safe.
evidenceExamples: Path traversal / upload / XXE / SSRF findings

controls.title: API and Web Service
controls.summary: REST/GraphQL/RPC services enforce authentication, authorization, validation, and anti-CSRF/SSRF.

controls.title: Configuration
controls.summary: Build, dependency, and deployment configuration is hardened with secure defaults and headers.
